title: [Chapitre] IX et IX bis. [Ateliers] : notes manuscrites (05-15/07/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, inferred from this page and its neighbours. L is a totally ordered set, playing the role of a 'line'. U is the set of its basic strata:
- the points a of L;
- the bounded open intervals I_{a,b} = ]a,b[ with a < b.

Û ('generalized strata') adds the unbounded intervals I_{<a} (only when a is not minimal) and I_{>b} (only when b is not maximal).

The previous page puts a partial order ≤ on Û (X lies to the left of Y), written in terms of δX, the boundary/endpoint data. It has special clauses forcing:
- I_{>a} ≤ Y implies Y = X;
- X ≤ I_{<a} implies X = Y;
- I_{<a} ≤ I_{>b} iff a ≤ b.

It then defines the 'separation' relation X|∘|Y :⇔ X<Y or Y<X. Equivalently, {X,Y} is a 2-element flag (Drap) of (Û,≤). It checks axioms Mag 1–4 of some axiomatic notion (a 'magma'-like structure of incidence/separation). Mag 3 is heredity under passing to sub-strata X'⊂⊂X, Y'⊂⊂Y.

This page. The page opens with a crossed-out lemma: cos-W°(I_{<a}) = {a} ∪ Omb°(I_{>a}), using 'Omb' (shadow) and 'W' operators.

The kept lemma: U is 'very dense' (très dense) in Û. That is, for X,Y ∈ Û, X|∘|Y holds iff X'|∘|Y' for all X' ˇ< X and Y' ˇ< Y with X',Y' ∈ U. Here ˇ< means 'is a sub-stratum of'. The lemma is written 'il faut', but the intended statement is an equivalence: necessity is the heredity Mag 3, and sufficiency is what is proved. A marginal note says it suffices to vary X' only, keeping Y.

Proof.
1. The only nontrivial case is when X or Y is an unbounded interval. Say X = I_{<a}.
2. Then X|∘|Y iff I_{<a} < Y, i.e. a ≤ Y.
3. Assume X'|∘|Y for all X' ⊂ I_{<a} in U.
4. Take X' = I_{a',a} with a' < a; such a' exists because a is not minimal.
5. Then Y|∘|I_{a',a}, so Y ≥ a or Y ≤ a'.
6. If Y ≤ a', then Y would be a sub-stratum of I_{<a}. Taking X' = Y gives Y|∘|Y, which is absurd since the relation is irreflexive.
7. Hence Y ≥ a, so X|∘|Y.

A line 'Condition avec ℓ' is started and abandoned.

Corollary: the flags/supports Σ for Û correspond to (are 'equivalent to') those for U. In other words, adjoining the unbounded strata does not change the separation combinatorics.

Purpose. The next page uses this to work with finite 'generalized polyfigures', i.e. finite flags of (Û,≤). Each is encoded by its trace flag T = δΦ in L together with a set of interstitial strata: I_{<t1}, t1, I_{t1,t2}, …, tn, I_{>tn}. This is a combinatorial model of finite stratifications of a 1-dimensional ordered space.
errors: The lemma literally says 'il faut' (necessary condition), but the proof establishes sufficiency. The intended statement is the equivalence, with necessity coming from Mag 3.
Step 'take X'=Y' assumes Y ∈ U. If Y is itself an unbounded interval I_{<c} with c ≤ a', one must instead take some X' ∈ U inside Y. This is an easy fix, but it is not addressed.
Symmetric cases are omitted: X = I_{>b}, and both X and Y unbounded. The 'p.ex.' covers them only implicitly.
The page ends with an abandoned line ('Condition avec ℓ') and a corollary stated without proof.

ideas.what: Completion of the poset of strata of a totally ordered set by unbounded intervals, with the strict-order 'separation' relation |∘| defined via 2-element flags
ideas.modern_name: Face poset / stratification poset of an ordered line; combinatorial (o-minimal-style) cell decomposition in dimension 1
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard combinatorics (cell decompositions; van den Dries for o-minimal cell decompositions)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme mentions 'topologie modérée' only in general terms

ideas.what: Density lemma: separation between generalized strata is detected on ordinary (bounded) sub-strata
ideas.modern_name: Density / approximation of the completed stratum poset by bounded strata

ideas.what: Polyfigures = finite flags of strata, encoded by a flag in L plus interstitial strata
ideas.modern_name: Flags in face posets / stratified point configurations on a line

missed.claim: Grothendieck develops an axiomatic ('Mag 1–4') theory of separation relations on strata, with operators Omb (shadow) and W, as part of a larger combinatorial framework of 'polyfigures'. The mathematics on this page is elementary, but the axiomatic framework itself is an undocumented 1986 project.
missed.quote: Lemme U est très dense dans Û, i.e. pour X, Y ∈ Û, pour qu'on ait X |∘| Y, il faut que pour tout X' ˇ< X, Y' ˇ< Y ... on ait X' |∘| Y'
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Mainly of historical interest: it documents a late (1986) attempt at a combinatorial/axiomatic tame topology. The lemma itself is routine.

deep.surprise_reason: An elementary verification lemma about strata of a totally ordered set. It is historically interesting as part of an unpublished axiomatic framework, but it contains no nontrivial mathematics.
transcription_corrections: 'il y a constant[?], on a un minimal' is better read as '(a non minimal)' or similar, justifying the existence of a' < a.
The crossed-out lemma at the top is more likely 'Lemme a) Soit a ∈ L non minimal, et ... I_{<a} est défini. Alors ...'.
'Les éléments[?] [?] supportant ΣÛ est [?] [?] aux[?] supports ΣU' is plausibly 'Les ... supportant ΣÛ est correspondante/équivalente à ... supports ΣU'; the image is hard to read.
